description: Chargy is desktop software for inspecting and validating secure electric-vehicle charging records. Its repository describes checking transparent charging processes against German calibration-law requirements and related European charging rules. Users open a charging transaction or signed meter record; the tool checks its structure and evidence and reports validation results for that session. Geographic and regulatory coverage is strongest for the German and European charging schemes named by the provider. GitHub metadata states AGPL-3.0 licensing, and the README identifies Windows, macOS and Linux builds. A limitation is that a valid transaction record does not establish charger availability, queueing or grid capacity. Applicable metering rules may change, so legal conformance should be checked against current authority documents. Chargy can prepare trusted charging-session observations for EV infrastructure demand simulations. The related catalogue AequilibraE model handles travel-network analysis, not charger record validation. No charging records or installer were downloaded.
name: Chargy charging-session validation tool
